ideas.idea: Expose the production origin from geo.config.json as Eleventy global data and use it for the canonical
ideas.why: Gives a concrete way to fix the canonical host using the existing config.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the insurance line
ideas.why: Reverses a deliberate, scoped choice that was declared fine.

ideas.idea: Extend the Dentist JSON-LD with url, address, openingHours, image, priceRange and sameAs
ideas.why: The schema is minimal and the address 12 Park Row, Leeds is in the page, so richer local business data helps machines.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite schema in base.njk and Person schema on the team page
ideas.why: Standard schema advice for any site, with little effect on a five-page site.

ideas.idea: Guard the meta description tag with {% if description %} in the template
ideas.why: base.njk renders content="" when description is missing, so a guard prevents empty tags.

ideas.idea: Replace vague claims with named dentists, GDC numbers, qualifications and photos on the team page
ideas.why: team.njk only says 'decades of experience', so verifiable names and credentials add real substance.

ideas.idea: Give services real detail, prices and per-service sections or pages
ideas.why: services.njk is a bare four-item list and says prices are clear without showing any.

ideas.idea: Add reviews, rating or credentials to back up 'Trusted by thousands' on the home page
ideas.why: index.njk makes an unsupported claim that proof would substantiate.

ideas.idea: Add FAQ content with FAQPage markup
ideas.why: Relies on the mandatory-FAQ folklore, and FAQ rich results are largely restricted.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card tags
ideas.why: Accurate since base.njk has none, but it is standard advice for any site.

ideas.idea: Add the missing /img/reception.jpg and passthrough copy for src/img
ideas.why: The image is referenced on the home page, but no file or passthrough exists, so it will 404.

ideas.idea: Add width, height and loading attributes to the image
ideas.why: Standard image advice with minimal effect on a single image.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap from collections with lastmod and exclude noindex pages
ideas.why: The sitemap is hand-written, passed through statically and already out of sync with noindex.

ideas.idea: Add explicit AI search bot groups to robots.txt
ideas.why: The report concedes User-agent: * with Allow: / already permits them, so the effect is small.
llms.txt is a stated non-issue and is folklore as a way to be found.

ideas.idea: Rewrite titles to include location and intent
ideas.why: Titles like 'Contact' and 'Thanks' are weak, and local intent is missing from several pages.

ideas.idea: Add header and footer landmarks with name, address and phone (NAP) on every page
ideas.why: base.njk has only nav and main, and NAP appears only on the contact page.
Vague advice that would apply to any site.
